name: cerebr-subgraph
description: Subgraph for the Cerebr protocol on X Layer (CBR bonding curve, Neural Circuit NFTs, fusion, ERC-6551 brain wallets)

scripts.abis: cd .. && forge build src/CerebrProcessor.sol src/CerebrCircuit.sol src/erc6551/IERC6551Registry.sol --out out-indexer --cache-path cache-indexer && jq '.abi' out-indexer/CerebrProcessor.sol/CerebrProcessor.json > indexer/abis/CerebrProcessor.json && jq '.abi' out-indexer/CerebrCircuit.sol/CerebrCircuit.json > indexer/abis/CerebrCircuit.json && jq '.abi' out-indexer/IERC6551Registry.sol/IERC6551Registry.json > indexer/abis/ERC6551Registry.json && rm -rf out-indexer cache-indexer
scripts.deploy:goldsky: graph build --network x1 && goldsky subgraph deploy cerebr/$npm_package_version --path .
scripts.deploy:local: graph create --node http://localhost:8020 cerebr && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 cerebr
